Five people, four men and one woman, were arrested in Palma on suspicion of
belonging to a group dedicated to drug trafficking, and 60 kilos of hashish and
weapons were seized.

The National Police's Grupo I de Estupefacientes concluded an investigation
begun months earlier that ended with five detainees, the force said in a
statement.

Officers learned of a hashish package addressed to a man living in Palma,
identified him, seized the package containing 24 kilos of hashish, and detained
him on suspicion of drug trafficking.

In the first home, that of the main suspect, officers found 36 kilos of hashish,
an air rifle with silencer and about 10,000 euros in cash; the man and a woman
were detained as suspected authors of drug trafficking and membership of a
criminal organisation.

In the second home, officers detained a second suspect accused of storing and
transporting drugs; they found 2 kilos of cocaine, cutting substance, a pistol
with 9 mm cartridges, a bow and arrows, and a hydraulic press.

A further person was detained in connection with the case. Officers suspect
the substance was distributed to third parties for small-scale sale; the
investigation remains open and further arrests are not ruled out.

Officers of the Prevention and Reaction Unit, Grupo II de Estupefacientes and

citizens and one Czech citizen, aged between 24 and 36, who had pleaded guilty
to the charges and none of whom had previously been convicted by a court.

prison, while the other two, who were additionally charged with marijuana
possession, were sentenced to one year and six months in prison, and the
judgments against the four accomplices are already final.

Per the tracker's scope rules, law changes, precedents and national statistics belong to the Cannabis Freedom Index history, not to an enforcement-event report. The only enforcement mention is a passing reference to a 2020 raid on the Haze Club in Johannesburg, with no date, arrests or quantity, so there is no single raid, seizure, arrest, prosecution or sentence to record as a tracker event.
